COMICCHESS-GEM_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}{IfUpgraded:show: and [aqua]1 Soul Lamp[/aqua]|}.
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.title: Gem Charge
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.description:

COMICCHESS-FIRST_CHANT.description: Add [blue]1[/blue] stack of [gold]Replay[/gold] to [gold]Second Chant[/gold] in your hand. Return this card to your hand.
COMICCHESS-SECOND_CHANT.title: Second Chant
COMICCHESS-SECOND_CHANT.description: [gold]Final Chant[/gold] in your hand hits [blue]1[/blue] additional time. Return this card to your hand.
COMICCHESS-FINAL_CHANT.title: Final Chant
COMICCHESS-FINAL_CHANT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies{Repeat:choose(1):| [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] times}.
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN.title: Awaken
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN.description:
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Awaken Fear+|Awaken Fear}[/gold] and [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Awaken Pain+|Awaken Pain}[/gold] to your hand.
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN_FEAR.title: Awaken Fear
COMICCHESS-AWAKEN_PAIN.title: Awaken Pain
COMICCHESS-BINDING_OATH_CURSE.title: Binding Oath (Curse)

COMICCHESS-SCRATCH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage{Repeat:choose(1):| [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] times}. The next time you play this card, it hits [blue]1[/blue] additional time.
COMICCHESS-PLAY_WITH.title: Play With
COMICCHESS-PLAY_WITH.selectionPrompt: Choose a card in your hand to [gold]Retain[/gold].
COMICCHESS-DARK_VEIL.title: Dark Veil
COMICCHESS-DARK_VEIL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have no [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold], gain {BonusBlock} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.title: Bind
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.description: Inflict [purple]Bound[/purple] on 1 card in your hand.
COMICCHESS-BIND_CARD.selectionPrompt: Choose a card in your hand to inflict [purple]Bound[/purple] on.
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON.title: Chains Prison
COMICCHESS-CHAINS_PRISON.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. When you gain [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold], the target takes {SoulLampDamage:diff()} damage.
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD.title: Soul Mold
COMICCHESS-SOUL_MOLD.description: The first time you play a Skill each turn, add a [gold]Fade[/gold] copy of it to your hand and inflict [purple]Bound[/purple] on that copy.
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL.title: Ashen Wall
COMICCHESS-ASHEN_WALL.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card with [gold]Fade[/gold], gain {BlockOnFadeExhaust:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-GEM_WHIRL.title: Gem Whirl
COMICCHESS-GEM_WHIRL.description: Draw {Draw:diff()} cards. At the start of your turn, play from your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold]. The next time you play this card, draw [blue]1[/blue] more card.
COMICCHESS-ALL_SOUL_SLASH.title: All-Soul Slash
COMICCHESS-ALL_SOUL_SLASH.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each card with [gold]Fade[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold], deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
COMICCHESS-SALVAGE.title: Salvage
COMICCHESS-SALVAGE.description: Can only be played if you have no [gold]Soul Lamp[/gold]. Draw {Draw:diff()} cards.
COMICCHESS-REMINISCE.title: Reminisce
COMICCHESS-REMINISCE.description:
Choose {Pick:diff()} [purple]Bound[/purple] card(s) from your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold] and return them to your hand.
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-STRONG_ADAPTABILITY.title: Strong Adaptability
COMICCHESS-STRONG_ADAPTABILITY.descripti: At the start of your turn, choose a card in your hand to upgrade.
COMICCHESS-TASTE.title: Taste
COMICCHESS-TASTE.description: ALL enemies gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. For each enemy, [aqua]gain 1 Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL.title: Willful
COMICCHESS-WILLFUL.description: At the start of your turn, [aqua]gain 1 Soul Lamp[/aqua].
COMICCHESS-YOU_ARE_MINE.title: You're Mine!
COMICCHESS-YOU_ARE_MINE.description: {Hits:diff()} times: apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] or [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy.
COMICCHESS-PURIFICATION_RITE.title: Purification Rite
COMICCHESS-FIRE_WALL.title: Fire Wall

Gain X [aqua]Soul Lamp[/aqua].

COMICCHESS-YOUR_SHARE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
When this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], lose {HpLossOnExhaust:diff()} HP.

COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_SEIZURE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Next turn, add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Seizure+|Hand of Seizure}[/gold] and [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Refusal+|Hand of Refusal}[/gold] to your hand.
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_REFUSAL.title: Hand of Refusal
COMICCHESS-HAND_OF_REFUSAL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Seizure+|Hand of Seizure}[/gold] and [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Hand of Refusal+|Hand of Refusal}[/gold] to your hand.
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
